description: This bar chart, from the paper "Context-Informed Grounding Supervision," illustrates the average performance of four different methods: "Standard Self-RAG," "FactTune," "ClinGS (w/)," and "ClinGS." The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," is scaled linearly from 0 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four methods in the order presented. Each method is represented by a single, vertically oriented bar with a distinct color: "Standard Self-RAG" is orange, "FactTune" is green, "ClinGS (w/)" is blue, and "ClinGS" is a darker blue. The bars are not sorted; they appear in the order listed on the x-axis. The approximate performance values are as follows: "Standard Self-RAG" is approximately 55, "FactTune" is approximately 53, "ClinGS (w/)" is approximately 55, and "ClinGS" is approximately 60. The bars are visually uniform in width and are not annotated or emphasized with special formatting such as outlines or shading.
